entries.title: NoteLLM：基于可验证 RAG 的个人学习问答系统

bullets.label: 目标：
bullets.text: 面向个人学习资料提供文档检索问答，保留可核查的引用与原文摘录。

bullets.label: 实现：
bullets.text: 使用 FastAPI、异步 SQLAlchemy、PostgreSQL 与 pgvector 实现余弦相似度检索；支持 PDF、Markdown、TXT 的按页提取与重叠分块。

bullets.label: 引用验证：
bullets.text: 在服务端验证引用是否来自检索分块，并保存原文摘录以支持来源核查。

bullets.label: 评测：
bullets.text: 7 份合成资料、34 道固定问题的单次基线测试：来源级 Recall@5 为 100%，自动引用来源匹配率为 97.1%，平均检索耗时 339 ms。

entries.note: 评测口径与局限：Recall@5 检查预期来源是否出现在前五个检索分块中；引用来源匹配率检查回答是否至少包含一条来自预期来源、经校验的引用。结果仅衡量该合成测试集的检索与引用来源匹配，不代表答案准确率或通用场景性能。

entries.title: NoteLLM: Personal Learning QA with Verifiable RAG

bullets.label: Purpose:
bullets.text: Document-based learning QA with verifiable citations and stored source excerpts.

bullets.label: Implementation:
bullets.text: Built cosine-similarity retrieval with FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, and pgvector; implemented page-aware extraction and overlapping chunks for PDF, Markdown, and TXT.

bullets.label: Citation validation:
bullets.text: Validated citations against retrieved chunks on the server and stored source excerpts for source verification.

bullets.label: Evaluation:
bullets.text: A single baseline on 7 synthetic documents and 34 fixed questions recorded 100% source-level Recall@5, 97.1% automatic citation-to-source match, and 339 ms mean retrieval latency.

entries.note: Evaluation scope: Recall@5 checks whether the expected source appears among the top five retrieved chunks; citation-to-source match checks whether an answer includes at least one validated citation from the expected source. Results measure retrieval and citation-source matching on this synthetic set, not answer accuracy or general-domain performance.
